newsitem.title: INDIA: Delhi shares dip on technical correction.
newsitem.headline: Delhi shares dip on technical correction.

text.p: Shares on the Delhi bourse quoted lower in early trade on Tuesday due to what brokers called a technical correction.
The Delhi Stock Exchange sensitive index was down 2.15 points at 863.35 after the first 30 minutes of trade.
"In the face of rising stock prices, this kind of technical correction was necessary," said Kishore Sial of brokers Pragat Financial Services.
ITC dipped 1.60 rupees to 497.50. The company on Monday announced it had signed an agreement with Britain's B.A.T Industries Plc on licensing of B.A.T brands to ITC.
State Bank of India declined 1.50 rupees to 339.50.
Hindustan Lever Ltd lost 12 rupees, falling to 1,282.
